lede: Anthony had the best week with 3 of 4, and Brian and Zach both blanked. Harrison took the Monday night game off Bill when Washington kicked a field goal on the last play, but the top barely moved: Mark 25, Jon 24, and four and a half points cover the top five.

beats.tag: Thanksgiving night · Kansas City at Buffalo
beats.text: Jon owns both sidelines, so one point is banked before kickoff. It is also the best game of the week — Buffalo 9-1, Kansas City 8-2, and Allen 5-1 against Mahomes in the regular season.
Mark against Patrick, both teams 8-2, first place in the NFC North. Chicago has won five straight without ever trailing; Detroit is 6-0 at home.
Philadelphia ended a seven-game losing streak against Pittsburgh, the Jets beat the Chargers, and Denver won a sixth in a row. His best week of the season.
Everyone has four games for the first time in a while. Zach owns both teams in Wednesday's Packers-Rams, so he banks one there too.
